authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 1388.1 ālu explicitly compares Hindi/Punjabi ālū, Nepali ālu and Oriya āḷū for potato, transferred from older edible-root senses. It marks some Bihari forms as Hindi loans; intra-IA transmission remains unresolved, while this family link is supported. Pumpkin/gourd forms and ālukī/arwī are excluded.
